title: SwyHub Auto Farm Auto Loot Auto Tycoon and More
features:
🪻 SwyHub — Pickaxe Tycoon ⛏️💎

Mine smarter, sell faster, and let your empire run itself with SwyHub — built on the redesigned Swy-UI v2.5 and powered by the new key-system-v2 loader for a frictionless experience.

🆕 New UI Experience:

• Modern glassmorphism interface with animated wave background

• Resizable window with persistent layout across sessions

• Built-in Settings (Anti-AFK, Pop-up Blocker, Auto Execute, Configuration, Interface) auto-mounted

• Live search bar across every tab and section

🌐 Dashboard Integration:

• One-click public Live Session link via swyhub.site/live

• Real-time stats: balance, sell pot, pickaxes, plot, gamepasses, income multiplier

• Cloud sync every 30 seconds — viewable without login

• Better control over your automation

🛠️ Core Features:

⛏️ Pickaxe Tycoon Engine:

Fully unattended ramp-up — Auto Buy pickaxes by 1 / 5 / 25 / 100 per touch and Auto Merge into higher tiers, scaling your plot from empty to max capacity without input.

🌾 Loot Pickup:

Range-based ore vacuum that fires LootPickup for every tier in radius. Configurable pickup range (10–500 studs) and tick interval (0.1–3s).

💰 Auto Sell:

Touch-driven anvil pipeline — Auto Deposit, Auto Collect Money, and Auto Upgrade Anvil all gated by a single tick slider (0.5–10s) for surgical pacing.

📦 Chest Automation:

• Auto Unlock the held chest as soon as one is picked up

• Auto Discard chests below the selected tier (Chest1 through Chest6)

• Keep only the rares, no clutter

🎁 Reward Automation:

Automatically claims Offline Income, Group Rewards, and the Ore Multiplier activation zone — every passive bonus gets touched the moment it appears.

🚀 Teleports:

• Plot quick-jumps: Spawn, Sell Anvil, Loot Trough, Buy Buttons, Offline Income

• World: Ore Multiplier Pad

• Server-side Teleport Home

🏃 Movement Tools:

• WalkSpeed (16–80) and JumpPower (50–300) sliders

• Infinite Jump

• Noclip with auto-restore on respawn

🛡️ Utility Systems:

• Always-on Anti-AFK (VirtualUser idle replay)

• Pop-up blocker that closes Roblox event / community / invite dialogs blocking VIM clicks

• Auto Execute on rejoin, server hop, and crashes — last config restored automatically

• Plot owner detection locks every action to your assigned plot

⚙️ Settings:

Advanced configuration system with Save / Load support for quick setup and personalized profiles. AutoSave runs on every element change — no manual save needed.

⚠️ Development & Updates:

SwyHub is actively maintained with continuous improvements, bug fixes, and new automations shipping through the key-system-v2 bundle — same loader URL, always the latest build.
